verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show Vercel's own AI surface (Vercel Agent) accepting user-plugged MCP servers as a client. The only MCP-consumption evidence is a developer building block: deploy MCP servers with mcp-handler, then call their tools from agents you build with the AI SDK, eve, or TanStack AI. That earns no credit under the partial-credit rules. Vercel's official MCP server is the server role and does not transfer to this client story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers on Vercel with mcp-handler, then call their tools from agents built with the AI SDK, eve, or TanStack AI.
